title: ULI Envelope
description: Universal Layer of Interoperability message envelope. Every message that crosses a service boundary uses this shape.

messageId.description: Unique per message - used by consumer inbox tables for idempotency.

correlationId.description: Shared across all messages in one logical request.

causationId.description: messageId of the message that caused this one.

subject.description: Hierarchical subject path - first segment is always 'uli'.

type.description: Canonical class/record name of the payload.

headers.description: Arbitrary string metadata - tenant, user, trace context.

payload.description: The message body. Schema validated separately by `type`.
